plans.subtitle: Start with Free, choose Plus for 10× the weekly usage of Free, or Pro for 10× Plus and confidential mode. Agents are included in every plan.

plans.billingNote: Prices are in USD. Plus and Pro are billed monthly. Free, Plus and Pro usage resets weekly.
plans.trialNote: Eligible new subscribers can start a 30-day Pro trial. A payment card is required; after the trial, Pro renews at $30/month unless canceled. Free requires no card.

trust.title:
Four things every Fluso desktop plan
gets by default.
trust.subtitle: Every Fluso desktop plan shares the same core workspace, open models and European hosting. Choose the usage and privacy level you need.

items.label: Usage
items.heading: Room for your work
items.body: Free gives you enough to get started. Plus includes 10× the weekly usage of Free. Pro includes 10× Plus. See your usage percentage and reset time in the app.

items.label: Models
items.heading: Open-source, always
items.body: Open-source models only, hosted in Europe. No proprietary APIs in the pipeline.

items.label: Hosting
items.heading: Hosted in Europe
items.body: Compute, storage and orchestration all run from European datacentres. GDPR-aligned, sovereign by design.

items.label: Privacy
items.heading: Your data, your boundary
items.body: Your work never trains shared models. Confidential computing on Pro and Enterprise, encrypted sandboxes for organisations that ask.
